BiblicalUsage: Sennacherib was the king of Assyria who came up against all the fenced cities of Judah in Hezekiah's fourteenth year and sent his servants to Jerusalem to demand surrender. Hezekiah prayed, Isaiah answered, and Sennacherib went home to Nineveh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God answers the prayers of a king who trusts Him, and this is the proof: the boasting army went home, and Jerusalem stood.
